search_text: published ZDI-07-001 ZDI-CAN-073 QUALCOMM Eudora WorldMail Remote Management Heap Overflow Vulnerability 2007-01-05 CVE-2006-6336 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2006-6336 ['QUALCOMM'] ['Eudora'] This vulnerability allows attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Eudora WorldMail. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists during the parsing of successive delimiters within the Mail Management Server, MAILMA.exe, listening on TCP port 106. Processing a maliciously crafted request can result in an exploitable heap corruption. QUALCOMM will not be addressing this issue with a software patch and instead recommends that administrators block access to the affected port from untrusted sources at the network level. ['2006-09-15 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2007-01-05 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Leon Juranic, INFIGO IS https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-07-001/
